current_point.claim: 利用区块稀疏（block-sparse）等技术实现细-粗粒度注意力（FC-Attention）的高效编码，使模型相较于原始Transformer具有更低的存储和计算复杂度，能够建模超过3倍长的音乐序列且具有更快的运行速度。
current_point.claim_en: We achieve efficient implementation of the fine- and coarse-grained attention (FC-Attention) with techniques such as block-sparse, enabling the model to have lower storage and computation complexity than vanilla Transformer, and to model over 3 times longer music sequences with a faster running speed.
source_locations: 第三章 3.5.3 FC-Attention 的高效实现
第四章 4.5 复杂度分析
technical_features: 使用区块稀疏（block-sparse）技术实现FC-Attention的高效编码
相较于原始Transformer具有更低的存储和计算复杂度
能够建模超过3倍长的音乐序列
technical_features_en: Efficient implementation of FC-Attention with techniques such as block-sparse
Lower storage and computation complexity than vanilla Transformer
Can model over 3 times longer music sequences
